name: Bhagwati Autocast Limited
about: Bhagwati Autocast Limited engages in the manufacture and sale of cast iron and spheroidal graphite iron castings in India. It provides cylinder blocks, crank cases, hydraulic lift housings, gear box and clutch housings/differential housings, and front axle support for tractors, as well as gear and power industry housings. The company was incorporated in 1981 and is based in Ahmedabad, India.
